async def safe(cid, svc, op, params=None, region=R):

        return await call(svc, op, params, region)
    except Exception as e:
        rec(cid, "ERROR", f"{svc}:{op} failed: {str(e)[:240]}"); return None

        rec("P-5","PASS" if st and "AWSCURRENT" in st[0] else "FAIL",f"{name} version {pin} stages {st}")

    ("public ENIs","ec2","DescribeNetworkInterfaces",{"Filters":[{"Name":"association.public-ip","Values":["*"]}]},"NetworkInterfaces")]:

    rec("P-8","PASS" if re.search(rf'"DbInstanceIdentifier": ?"{C}-pg"',g["Target"].get("Input","")) else "FAIL","database input names munaxa-nonprod-pg")
